title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Right neck from above, patient supine, head turned to the left: head at the top, the patient's right (posterior neck) on the image left, as the anatomy plate and the interscalene plate.
teachingPoint: Probe transverse over the mid-SCM, across its posterior border; needle in-plane from the posterior end, its path clear of the external jugular vein.
claims: Right neck from above, head turned left; posterior on the image left, the same way round as the anatomy plate (camera reused from the approved interscalene plate).
Linear probe transverse over the midpoint of the SCM, across its posterior border (record subtitle and steps 1-2; plexus at the SCM's midpoint, record anatomy).
External jugular vein crossing the SCM near this level, over the posterior border about 1 cm below the probe (record anatomy, step 3; exact crossing point is a drawn assumption).
Needle entering just beyond the probe's posterior end, in line: in-plane from posterior to anterior, off the external jugular (record, steps 3-4).
Labels: Block needle, Linear probe, External jugular vein, SCM posterior border.
